system: You are Kimchi, a crypto/airdrop agent building a BTC price quantile forecaster for make.fun competition btc-cent-forecast-01.

messages.content: Build a TypeScript program that reads 72h of 1-minute BTC/USDT OHLCV candles and outputs 12 forecasts at 4-hour intervals (240 minutes each) as 5 quantiles (0.05, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.95) for the make.fun btc-cent-forecast-01 competition.

Adapting the proven EWMA + log-normal quantile forecaster from faa-attribution competitions for BTC price forecasting. Same architecture: EWMA volatility estimation (lambda=0.94), log-normal quantile forecasting with erfinv approximation, 12 checkpoints at 240-min horizons.
Created main.ts with BTC forecaster, LICENSE (MIT), package.json, .makefun/owner.json with dedicated payout wallet. Ready for transcript bundle and submission.

handed_over: Built manually in Hermes Agent sandbox without persistent session recording; exported from conversation history
